Colon Cancer Treatment (PDQ) - Health Professional Version

General Information About Colon Cancer

Risk Factors

Increasing age is the most important risk factor for most cancers, including colorectal cancer in adults.[3]

[Level of evidence: 3iiA]

Family history matters:

Too short.

Treatment of Stage I Colon Cancer

Treatment of stage I colon cancer is primarily surgical resection with adequate margins, with no adjuvant therapy needed.[1,2]

Treatment of Stage IV and Recurrent Colon Cancer

Patients with unresectable metastatic disease are treated with systemic chemotherapy, with or without targeted biologic agents, to prolong survival.
